title: Artin–Schreier formulas helper
statement: Let f : C → Spec k be a curve [def-sc-curves] over an algebraically closed field k of positive characteristic p. Let G be an abelian sheaf on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and suppose additive equivalences a_U : G(U) ≃ Gamma(U,O_U) commute with restrictions. There exist wp : G → G and iota : C.constantZMod p → G [def-sc-constant-sheaves] with iota ≫ wp = 0, a_U(wp_U(x)) = a_U(x)^p - a_U(x), and a_U(iota_U(eta_U(c))) = (c.val : Gamma(U,O_U)) for each c in ZMod p; eta is the constant-presheaf sheafification unit [def-weil-pbc-sheafification].

proof.text: Positive field characteristic is prime. Pulling functions back along U → C → Spec k gives p = 0 in Gamma(U,O_U), even on the empty U. Binomial expansion proves additivity of x^p - x. Conjugation by the natural a_U defines wp; ring-homomorphic restrictions preserve powers and subtraction, so its components are natural.

The ring map ZMod p → k → Gamma(U,O_U), obtained from the field cast and pullback of functions, sends c to c.val even when Gamma(U,O_U) is trivial. Composing its additive map with ULift.down and a_U inverse gives a natural additive constant-presheaf map. Extend it through sheafification to iota using sheafifyLift. The extension equation and the definition of wp give the two section formulas.
Fermat gives c^p = c in ZMod p, so the composite with wp is zero before sheafification. Uniqueness of the extension then implies iota ≫ wp = 0.

lean.statement:
theorem artinSchreier_formulas
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    {C : Scheme.{u}} (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f]
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p)
    (G : Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (a : ∀ U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ, G.obj.obj U ≃+ Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))
    (hrestr : ∀ (U V : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (g : U ⟶ V) (x : G.obj.obj U),
      a V (G.obj.map g x) = g.unop.left.appTop (a U x)) :
    ∃ (wp : G ⟶ G) (iota : C.constantZMod p ⟶ G) (_hzero : iota ≫ wp = 0),
      (∀ (U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : G.obj.obj U),
        a U (wp.hom.app U x) = (a U x) ^ p - a U x) ∧
      (∀ (U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (c : ZMod p),
        a U (iota.hom.app U
          ((toSheafify C.smallEtaleTopology
            ((Functor.const C.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj
              (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod p))))).app U (ULift.up c))) =
          (c.val : Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤)))
